title: recommendeddocument
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdbyname, createdonbehalfbyname, modifiedbyname, modifiedonbehalfbyname, organizationid, transactioncurrencyidname.

absoluteurl.description: Type the URL where the recommended document is located.

associatedrecordname.description: Shows the associated record name of the recommended document.

author.description: Shows the name of the author of the recommended document.

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

editurl.description: Shows the Edit URL of the recommended document.

exchangerate.description: Shows the exchange rate for the currency associated with the recommended document with respect to the base currency.

externalmodifiedby.description: Shows who last updated the document record.

fullname.description: Shows the full name of the recommended document.

iconclassname.description: Stores the Icon Class name of the recommended document.

location.description: Shows the location of the recommended document.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

readurl.description: Shows the Read URL of the recommended document.

source.description: Shows the source storage of the recommended document.

title.description: Type a title for the entity.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Shows the time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

_createdby_value.description: Shows the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record on behalf of another user.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Shows the exchange rate for the currency associated with the recommended document with respect to the base currency.
